posts.title: six
posts.description: When I was younger I loved Kingdom Hearts. I loved playing it but the character that stuck to me the most was Naminé. I think she was my favorite because she wasn't always in the main limelight. She was always had a big part to play in it, somewhat, but regardless she was involved in some way shape or form in the series. That's why I liked her. She mattered in some way but she wasn't always there.

posts.title: four
posts.description: It's officially my birthday. I've spent most of this weekend ill, and it's really frustrating. I'm too busy to celebrate, I've always been, but I think I'm getting tired. Tired of working so hard, tired of putting myself last, and tired of being so sick all the time. I really want to be more active, write more, make things, and work on my website but it's been difficult. My health is just not good
